caption: Per-type missile profiles (issue #1470, phase 2): two player Archers regiments stand 290 wu (14.5 m) from an enemy regiment. The left one carries the new pilum profile (15 m / 300 wu reach, thrown flat, 2 s cadence, accuracy halving by maximum range) and opens fire on its own at that range -- past the old global 8 m / 160 wu reach and the 190 wu detection default -- while the right one keeps the default bow profile and holds, the enemy out of both its reach and its sight. A ranged unit now shoots with its own profile's range, cadence, damage factor, accuracy falloff, and launch angle (a flat throw lands sooner than a lob), all metre-authored and caller-configurable; an unprofiled unit shoots exactly as before.
